reviewNotes:
Twinfold is a web browser that shows two web pages at once. On iPhone Duo (unfolded) the two pages meet at the fold, one above and one below; held sideways they sit side by side. On the cover display or any other iPhone, the split button in the bottom bar shows two stacked pages with a handle to resize them.

To try it: open any site, tap the split button (bottom bar), and open another site in the second pane. Tap a pane to make it active (teal outline): the address bar acts on it. Touch and hold a link > Open in Other Pane. Menu > Save as Pair saves both pages; pairs also appear as Home Screen quick actions.

The app is free, with no in-app purchases, no account, no server and no analytics. Ads and trackers are blocked with a built-in WebKit content rule list. The screenshots show sample pages bundled with the app (invented sites).
